title: MemoryBackend hasMention matches any non-empty mentions
description: crate-jmap-chat-server/src/memory.rs (~line 3690, filter hasMention) treats any non-empty `mentions` array as mentioning the owner. Draft §Message/query: hasMention matches when "the owner's ChatContact.id appears in `mentions`, OR `broadcastMentions` contains a scope whose resolved recipient set includes the owner." A message mentioning only another user ({"id":"u1"}) wrongly matches hasMention:true. Fix: compare each Mention.id against the owner ChatContact.id. Found during JMAP-yt1w.17 test review.
notes:
Also in the same filter (memory.rs broadcast_mention_matches_owner, ~line 3518): scope "admins" resolves to true unconditionally ('single-user = always admin'). Draft §Message/query hasMention matches when 'broadcastMentions contains a scope whose resolved recipient set includes the owner'; since JMAP-yt1w.33 the owner is an admin only if its Space member entry (accountId) holds admin permissions, so 'admins' should resolve against that entry. Found while fixing JMAP-yt1w.33.
Folded into JMAP-y3f2 (Chat core server conformance (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00)) by the 2026-10-19 spec gap audit.
